notes: Parameterized practice bank: 132 topic/band families with ten input variants and five question formats.
Difficulty labels indicate progression within a family, not independently calibrated expert difficulty.
Runtime checks cover supported local interpreters only, including the extra input used in B comparisons.
Theory and vendor GUI/model exercises have reference links but are not independently certified.
Code creation requires self-review; this website never executes submitted code.
